title: Seiu Cope (Service Employees International Union Committee on Political Education) spent $369.4K supporting Bill Halter for the Senate (AR)
summary: Seiu Cope (Service Employees International Union Committee on Political Education) reported $369,441.26 supporting Bill Halter for the Senate (AR): tv ads air 6/2+, paid to The New Media Firm, Inc.; reported 2010-06-03, as filed with the FEC.
